photoSkips.why: reviewed: Firehouse No. 1 building; not shown to be this bar

sample.name: Picchetti Winery
facts: The Picchetti brothers began making their own wine in 1896.
Leslie Pantling took over the winery in 1998 and resumed production.
The 1989 film Blood Red was filmed at the winery.

sample.name: Guildhouse
facts: Social gaming venue for adult gamers combining drinks and table-top games.
Offers themed cocktails and gaming tournaments.
Has Wi-Fi

sample.name: The Wine Room
facts: Housed in a Ramona Street building designed by Pedro de Lemos.
Pours boutique wines from around the world by the glass.
Has outdoor seating

sample.name: Miniboss
facts: Arcade bar with more than 30 classic arcade games and a dozen pinball machines.
Serves Detroit-style pizzas and wings alongside inventive cocktails.
Address: 52 East Santa Clara Street, San Jose

sample.name: Duke of Edinburgh
facts: Founded in 1983 by English expats Stan Gamble, David Neale and Robert Gaines Cooper, with Bob Blair.
The pub interior was built by craftsmen in Suffolk and shipped to California in two containers.
Address: 10801 N Wolfe Rd, Cupertino

sample.name: District
facts: Bar in San Pedro Square serving small shareable plates, pizza and house-made charcuterie.
Runs an extensive wine and whiskey program.
Address: 65 North San Pedro Street, San Jose

sample.name: Kepler's Books
facts: Peace activist Roy Kepler founded the bookstore in May 1955.
It helped lead the Bay Area paperback revolution alongside Cody's and City Lights.
The store moved to its current Menlo Center location in 1989.

sample.name: Leigh's Favorite Books
facts: Opened in 2004 by Leigh Odum as a new and used bookstore.
Its children's sister store Bookasaurus opened in 2012 next door.
Address: 121 South Murphy Avenue, Sunnyvale

sample.name: The Continental
facts: Occupies the former location of Brix/Hunters and Sal & Luigi's/Mac's next to the California Theatre.
Has a patio and hosts live music and DJs.
Address: 349 South 1st Street, San Jose

sample.name: Fibbar MaGees
facts: Opened in 1994 as an Irish pub on historic Murphy Avenue.
Serves craft beers and Irish fare with a large selection of Irish whiskeys.
Opened in 1994

sample.name: Hedley Club
facts: Cocktail lounge and wine bar inside the Hotel De Anza with art-deco design.
Hotel De Anza, home of the lounge, is a 1920s art deco building.
Hosts live music many nights of the week.

sample.name: Bar Underdog
facts: Opened in September 2025 on California Avenue from the team behind Michelin-starred Protégé.
Operates as part of DNA Hospitality.
Address: 299 California Ave, Palo Alto

sample.name: Paper Plane
facts: Cocktail bar on South First Street serving artisan-style cocktails plus wine and beer.
Pairs its drinks with a small food menu.
Run by Barrel Proof, Incorporated

sample.name: 55 South
facts: Bar with live music and big screen TVs, serving American and Mediterranean dishes.
Serves bottomless mimosas and french toast kebabs on Sundays.
Brews its own beer

sample.name: Linden Tree Books
facts: Linda and Dennis Ronberg started Linden Tree in 1981 and opened a Los Altos storefront in 1984.
The store moved to its current State Street location in 2011.
Chris Saccheri and Flo Grosskurth bought the store in September 2019.

sample.name: The Old Wagon Saloon & Grill
facts: Bar with an old west theme in San Pedro Square, serving American cuisine and BBQ.
Smokes meats in-house in a smoker named Madame Stacie.
Address: 73 North San Pedro Street, San Jose

sample.name: Steins Beer Garden
facts: Opened in March 2013, conceived by founder Ted Kim after visiting German beer gardens.
Hosted the official Mountain View Oktoberfest until 2025.
Ricky Singh took over as owner in 2025, just before the planned March closure.

sample.name: The Caravan Lounge
facts: Began inside the San Jose Greyhound station as one of several Caravan Lounges in California bus terminals.
Owner Leo Chargin opened the current location in 1964 on a former used car lot.
Focuses on live music, karaoke and comedy nights.

sample.name: Menlo Park Farmers Market
facts: The market opened in 1992 and is sponsored by the Menlo Park Live Oak Lions Club.
It runs year round on Sundays in a parking lot on Chestnut Street.
Opened in 1992

sample.name: Books, Inc
facts: Books Inc. describes itself as the West's oldest independent bookseller.
The store hosts author events on Castro Street.
Wheelchair accessible

sample.name: Moods Wine Bar & Bistro
facts: Opened in Palo Alto in 2017 by Mahmood and KC Saljooqi, then moved to Sunnyvale.
Menu features Afghan dishes such as khorma and aushak dumplings.
Address: 111 West Evelyn Avenue, Sunnyvale
